info.name: Stakflo GRC — Tool Integrations
info.description:
All routes from `app.integrations.api.mount_integration_routes`.

**Variables:** `baseUrl`, `org_id`, `tool_id`, `user_id`, `oauth_code`, `oauth_state`, `snyk_api_token`, `snyk_org_id`, `aws_role_arn`, `aws_region`, `aws_sts_region`, `aws_external_id`, `aws_evidence_codes`, `prisma_api_base_url`, `prisma_access_key_id`, `prisma_secret_key`, `defender_tenant_id`, `defender_client_id`, `defender_client_secret`, `defender_subscription_id`, `orca_api_host`, `orca_api_token`, `lacework_account`, `lacework_key_id`, `lacework_secret`, `aqua_api_base_url`, `aqua_login_id`, `aqua_password`, `sysdig_api_base_url`, `sysdig_api_token`, `cs_falcon_api_base_url`, `cs_falcon_client_id`, `cs_falcon_client_secret`, `cs_falcon_member_cid`, `dfe_tenant_id`, `dfe_client_id`, `dfe_client_secret`, `dfe_api_base_url`, `s1_api_base_url`, `s1_api_token`, `tio_access_key`, `tio_secret_key`, `tio_api_base_url`, `qualys_username`, `qualys_password`, `qualys_api_base_url`, `r7_api_base_url`, `r7_username`, `r7_password`, `tan_api_base_url`, `tan_api_token`.

**Wiz:** service account — `graphql_url`, `client_id`, `client_secret`.

**Prisma Cloud:** CSPM REST — `api_base_url` (tenant API URL per pan.dev), `access_key_id`, `secret_key`; JWT via POST /login. Seed evidence EV-701.. with `source=prisma_cloud` before collect.

**Snyk:** API key / OAuth; `org_ids` or `group_id`.

**AWS (Cloud):** `POST .../integrations/cloud/aws/configure` with `configuration_data.role_arn` (IAM role ARN — **no region in ARN**; account ID only). Server credentials must allow `sts:AssumeRole`. Optional: `region` (default `us-east-1`), `region: "auto"` (multi-region via EC2 DescribeRegions), `sts_region` (AssumeRole endpoint, default `us-east-1`), `external_id` (cross-account trust). Evidence: `POST .../evidence/aws/collect` — `evidence_codes` null collects all seeded Cloud EV codes; or pass e.g. `["EV-16","EV-541"]`. Seed `evidence_masters` for the tool domain (app upsert or `scripts/sql/seed_aws_evidence_masters_cloud_domain.sql`).

**Okta:** `org_domain` + `api_token` (SSWS).

**Defender for Cloud:** Azure AD app (`tenant_id`, `client_id`, `client_secret`) + `subscription_id`; OAuth2 client credentials for `https://management.azure.com/.default`. Seed EV-711.. `source=defender_cloud`.

**Orca Security:** `api_token` + optional `api_host` (default `api.orcasecurity.io`); base URL `https://{host}/api`. Seed EV-721.. `source=orca_security`.

**Lacework:** `lacework_account` (subdomain) + `lacework_key_id` + `lacework_secret`; API v2 at `https://{account}.lacework.net/api/v2`. Seed EV-731.. `source=lacework`.

**Aqua Security (self-hosted CSP):** `aqua_api_base_url` (console origin, e.g. `https://aqua.example.com:8443`) + `login_id` + `password`; REST v1 under `/api/v1`. Seed EV-741.. `source=aqua_security`. Aqua SaaS uses a different sign-in flow — not covered by this integration.

**Sysdig Secure:** `sysdig_api_base_url` (regional API host, e.g. `https://api.us1.sysdig.com`) + `sysdig_api_token`; `Authorization: Bearer`. Seed EV-751.. `source=sysdig_secure`.

**CrowdStrike Falcon:** `cs_falcon_api_base_url` (e.g. `https://api.crowdstrike.com`) + `cs_falcon_client_id` + `cs_falcon_client_secret`; OAuth2 `POST /oauth2/token`. Optional `cs_falcon_member_cid` (MSSP). Seed EV-761.. `source=crowdstrike_falcon`.

**Microsoft Defender for Endpoint:** `dfe_api_base_url` (e.g. `https://api.security.microsoft.com`) + `dfe_tenant_id` + `dfe_client_id` + `dfe_client_secret`; OAuth2 client credentials for Defender resource `https://api.securitycenter.microsoft.com` (see Microsoft Learn). Seed EV-771.. `source=defender_for_endpoint`.

**SentinelOne:** `s1_api_base_url` (management console origin, e.g. `https://usea1.sentinelone.net`, or full `.../web/api/v2.1`) + `s1_api_token` (`Authorization: ApiToken`). Seed EV-781.. `source=sentinelone`.

**Tenable.io:** `tio_api_base_url` (default `https://cloud.tenable.com`) + `tio_access_key` + `tio_secret_key` (`X-ApiKeys`). Seed EV-791.. `source=tenable_io`.

**Qualys:** `qualys_api_base_url` (e.g. `https://qualysapi.qualys.com`) + `qualys_username` + `qualys_password` (Basic). Seed EV-801.. `source=qualys`.

**Rapid7 InsightVM:** `r7_api_base_url` (e.g. `https://insightvm.example.com:3780`) + `r7_username` + `r7_password` (Basic to `/api/3`). Seed EV-811.. `source=rapid7_insightvm`.

**Tanium:** `tan_api_base_url` (console origin; `/api/v2` appended if missing) + `tan_api_token` (`session` header). Seed EV-821.. `source=tanium`.

**Sync:** `provider_key` optional: `zoho_people` | `microsoft_entra` | `microsoft_entra_gcc_high` | `bitbucket_cloud` | `wiz` | `prisma_cloud` | `defender_cloud` | `aqua_security` | `orca_security` | `lacework` | `sysdig_secure` | `crowdstrike_falcon` | `defender_for_endpoint` | `sentinelone` | `tenable_io` | `qualys` | `rapid7_insightvm` | `tanium` | `snyk` | `aws` | `jira_cloud` | `okta`.

request.description: Microsoft identity platform client credentials flow (Learn). Use access_token as Bearer for management.azure.com.
Authorization: Token <api_token> to https://{api_host}/api — see Cortex XSOAR Orca pack / Demisto content.
Lacework API v2: POST /access/tokens with X-LW-UAKS; see lacework/go-sdk and docs.lacework.net.
Self-hosted Aqua CSP: POST /api/v1/login per aquasecurity/terraform-provider-aquasec.
Bearer token; regional host per Sysdig API docs (api.us1.sysdig.com, etc.).
OAuth2 POST /oauth2/token (see CrowdStrike Developer Center OpenAPI).
Entra OAuth2 token then GET /api/machines (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API Hello World).
Single-region workload default (`aws_region`, e.g. us-east-1). IAM role ARNs do not encode region — only account ID.
Uses EC2 DescribeRegions after AssumeRole to scan multiple commercial regions (requires ec2:DescribeRegions on assumed role).
Cross-account: optional external_id on trust policy; sts_region controls which regional STS endpoint performs AssumeRole.
Collects every AWS evidence master linked to this tool's domain (see evidence_map AWS_SEED_ROWS).
Set collection variable `aws_evidence_codes` to a JSON array string, e.g. ["EV-16","EV-541"].
Explicit list of all Cloud-domain AWS seed codes (same as ALL_AWS_EVIDENCE_CODES in code).
Worker app OAuth2 client_credentials; token URL POST https://auth.pingone.{tld}/{envId}/as/token (PingOne docs).
